idea-plugin.name: Lattice
idea-plugin.description:
Lattice — In-App Database Manager for IntelliJ IDEA

A database client for IntelliJ IDEA. Connect to, explore, query, create, and modify your databases without leaving your editor.

Key Features:

  • Supported Databases: MySQL and HSQLDB with a compatible JDBC driver. Tested server releases include MySQL 5.5, 5.6, 5.7 and 8.4, and HSQLDB 2.2.9 through 2.7.4 (Embedded File, In-Memory, and Server modes).
  • Database Explorer: Tree view of Catalogs/Databases, Schemas, Tables, Views, Columns (with data types, primary key, and auto-increment indicators).
  • Interactive Data Grid: Inline cell editing with early type checking, auto-generated key protection, periodic auto-refresh, add/delete rows, batch commit, revert, filter (WHERE clause), and pagination.
  • SQL Query Console: Execute queries with syntax support, Ctrl+Enter execution, result tables, affected row counts, elapsed time, and query history.
  • Visual DDL Wizards: Create databases, design tables, alter tables (add, rename, modify definition, and drop columns), truncate tables, and rename tables.
  • Export: Export data directly to CSV, JSON, and SQL INSERTs, and export/view CREATE TABLE DDL.
idea-plugin.change-notes: IntelliJ IDEA 2025+ / Java 21 compatibility, selectable JDBC versions, verified downloads, local JAR selection, server-version detection, and older MySQL/HSQLDB compatibility fixes.
